description: Save a chatbot connector: where a chat channel is and how to reach it. For a chat widget on a web page that is the page address. Other kinds need a credential from the chat provider: do not ask a person to paste a secret into a conversation; those kinds are added in the web app. Saves the connector and contacts nothing. If a required value was not given (the phone number, what should be heard, what counts as success), ask for it; do not invent one. Say which optional settings are being left at their defaults. Use when: a chatbot is to be tested and listDigitalConnectors shows no connector for it.
